answer: Reaching the inlet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a developer-centric, implementation details matter register, it stays short. The ledge holds work receipts rather than names, so the jetty of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on recursive zk-SNARKs for scalable verification.
